accepted_answers.name: No clear winner (honest answer)
accepted_answers.why: Independent 2026 benchmarks disagree with each other (one ranks HumanizerAI first, another WriteHuman, another GPTHuman), bypass rates are detector- and version-dependent, and 'guaranteed bypass' is inherently unstable as detectors evolve.

notes: No clear winner — consensus is weak by design. This is an arms race between detector heuristics and paraphrasing strategies; results shift with detector updates. Different roundups crown different tools. Any ranking here must be treated as a dated snapshot, not durable ground truth. Also note ethical/policy risk: several vendors prohibit academic-misconduct use.
problem: Building or buying an 'AI humaniser' product that rewrites AI text to evade AI detectors.
